user.title: Gubbins inventory bridge
user.description: Connect to your local Gubbins bridge. The token is an API token minted in the Gubbins app (Users → an account → API tokens); it is stored securely by Home Assistant and never written to YAML.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Gubbins inventory bridge
zeroconf_confirm.description: Discovered a Gubbins bridge at {host}:{port}. Enter its access token (an API token minted in the Gubbins app (Users → an account → API tokens)) to finish. The token is never advertised over the network — it is stored securely by Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Gubbins inventory bridge
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge at {host}:{port} no longer accepts the stored token — it was probably revoked or rotated. Mint a new API token in the Gubbins app (Users → an account → API tokens) and enter it here to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Gubbins inventory bridge
reconfigure.description: Update where the bridge lives. Re-enter the access token — Home Assistant never displays a stored token, so it cannot be pre-filled here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge. Check the host and port, and that the bridge is running.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge did not recognise the token. It may have been mistyped, or revoked in the Gubbins app.

abort.already_configured: This Gubbins bridge is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Reconnected to the Gubbins bridge with the new token.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Gubbins bridge details were updated.

search.name: Search inventory
search.description: Search the Gubbins inventory (read-only) and return matching items, along with the resolved location ids for each match.

query.name: Query
query.description: Free text, or the power-user syntax (e.g. cap:voltage>3.3).

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1–25).

adjust_quantity.name: Adjust quantity (check in / out)
adjust_quantity.description: Change a discrete item's stock by a signed amount. Requires the bridge to be started with GUBBINS_BRIDGE_ALLOW_WRITES=on; the change syncs back to the app conflict-free.

item_id.name: Item id
item_id.description: The Gubbins record id of the item (find it via the search service or the API).

delta.name: Delta
delta.description: Signed change: negative to check out, positive to check in.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note recorded in the item's activity log.
